description: This file defines various loss functions utilized within the PyTorch C++ (LibTorch) neural network framework. It provides inline functions for computing different loss metrics such as L1, MSE, KL divergence, cosine embedding loss, and others, often encapsulating detailed internal implementations. The file sets up interface points for these loss functions and includes options to customize their behaviors.
